title: TDS on Contractor (194C)
shortAnswer: Calculate 1% or 2% TDS on contract payments.
longAnswer: Section 194C requires the payer to deduct TDS at 1% (for payments to individuals and HUFs) or 2% (for companies, firms, and others) on payments to contractors and sub-contractors for carrying out work. The threshold is ₹30,000 for a single payment or ₹1,00,000 in aggregate in a financial year. The TDS on Contractor Calculator takes the payment amount and the payee type to show the TDS to deduct and the net payable. The threshold is applied per contract or per payee, and the aggregate test runs through the year. If the contractor is registered under GST, the payment may also attract GST, but TDS and GST are separate. The contractor claims the TDS as a credit in their return. The calculator does not decide whether a payment is a 'work' under 194C or a 'professional service' under 194J—that depends on the nature of the contract. Confirm the rate and threshold on the e-filing portal.
